# Stroke

> Stroke is a fast, native desktop database client for engineers, data analysts, and autonomous AI agents. Query, browse, and edit every database you run in one lightweight app (macOS, Windows, Linux). It ships with a built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so AI coding assistants (Claude Desktop, Cursor, ChatGPT, Grok) can inspect schemas and execute SQL queries securely over local loopback.

Stroke connects directly to PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, DuckDB, ClickHouse, SQL Server, CockroachDB, Turso / LibSQL, and Cloudflare D1. Connections run directly over local sockets from the user's machine; credentials and query results never pass through external cloud servers. All features are free to evaluate with no account. A personal license is $9.99 once forever (2 devices, lifetime updates). Team license is $99 once for company domains.

## Technical Guides & Comparisons (Blog)

- [Database Client Comparison 2026: Stroke vs TablePlus vs DBeaver vs DataGrip](https://stroke.click/blog/stroke-vs-tableplus-dbeaver-datagrip): Benchmark comparison showing Stroke's 118ms cold start and 64MB RAM footprint versus TablePlus ($89/yr) and DBeaver (850MB+ Java heap).
- [Connecting AI Agents to Databases via Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://stroke.click/blog/mcp-database-client-guide-ai-agents): How Claude Desktop and Cursor connect to PostgreSQL and SQLite via localhost (127.0.0.1:4319) with strict read-only execution guardrails.
- [Why DuckDB Needs a Modern Native GUI](https://stroke.click/blog/duckdb-gui-client-local-analytics): Drag-and-drop Parquet file inspection, MotherDuck integration, and sub-second OLAP query execution on local datasets.
- [Top SQLite GUI Tools for Mac, Windows, and Linux](https://stroke.click/blog/sqlite-gui-tools-macos-windows-linux): In-depth comparison of SQLite browsers, WAL mode concurrency, LibSQL/Turso support, and Cloudflare D1 workflows.
- [Zero-Telemetry, Local-First Database Security](https://stroke.click/blog/local-first-database-security-ai): Why cloud-proxied database tools violate SOC 2 / HIPAA compliance and how Stroke encrypts credentials in native OS keychains.

## Quick MCP Server Configuration

Add Stroke's built-in MCP server to your AI agent's configuration (`claude_desktop_config.json` or `.cursor/mcp.json`):

\`\`\`json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "stroke": {
      "url": "http://127.0.0.1:4319/mcp"
    }
  }
}
\`\`\`

## Key Entity Details

- **Product Name**: Stroke (Stroke Database Client)
- **Domain**: stroke.click
- **Category**: Database Management Software / SQL Editor / Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
- **Platforms**: macOS (12+), Windows (10/11), Linux (x86_64, ARM64)
- **Supported Engines**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, DuckDB, ClickHouse, Microsoft SQL Server, CockroachDB, Turso / LibSQL, Cloudflare D1
- **Pricing**: $9.99 one-time perpetual license (2 devices, lifetime updates); $99 one-time team domain license
- **License**: Proprietary client with open-source core and extensions on GitHub (https://github.com/stroke-app/stroke)
- **Security Posture**: 100% Local-First, Zero Telemetry on queries/schemas, OS Keychain encryption (Apple Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, Linux Secret Service)
- **Full Text Reference**: [llms-full.txt](https://stroke.click/llms-full.txt)
